Definition: to soar, i.e. be lofty; figuratively, to be haughty
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be high, be exalted; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be high, lofty, tall; 1a2) to be exalted; 1a3) to be lofty; 1a3a) to be lofty (of Jehovah's ways-good sense); 1a3b) to be haughty, be arrogant (bad sense); 1b) (Hiphil) to make high, exalt
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
